text: The accepted EnvAddr getter acquires mLock and returns nsCString by value. EnvDate and MsgOffset return scalar snapshots under the same lock. Do not replace these with a borrowed parser pointer that outlives the lock without checking the ownership contract. This is a scoped getter/lock recommendation; the code was not run concurrently. title: A locked mbox getter returns an owned snapshot
